integrity: The analytic proof cites earlier Schur weighted trace-norm and graph symmetry results. Checker diagnostics are finite checks only and are not certificates of a universal statement or novelty.
scientific_limitations: Only zero-one differences P-Q of blocky masks with Q<=P; positive sums of two blocky masks and the full complexity-two interior problem remain unresolved. Known off-diagonal values and 9/7 precedent credited. Source comparisons include partially inspected older works. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: The discrete norm spectrum of differences of two blocky Schur projections
